pages.title: Cannon Launch
pages.creator: New Reach Venture
pages.description: Cannon Launch sends your character flying from a cannon across a futuristic skyline. Choose your aim, fire and bounce along the terrain. TNT crates and rocket rings can extend a launch, and Ultra Overdrive helps you cover more ground. Collect coins and diamonds in the air to unlock animal characters, hats and new environments.

pages.title: Woolloop! Color Puzzle
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Woolloop! Color Puzzle sends bobbins along a conveyor belt to collect yarn of the same color. Each bobbin can hold only so much, so check both the shade and the remaining room before making a choice. Use the moving bobbins to collect the yarn in the right order and complete the pattern.

pages.title: Food Tower Defense
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description: Food Tower Defense asks you to set up food-themed towers to hold off enemies. Drag a tower into a spot where it can reach the attackers, then click a placed tower when you want to upgrade it. Look at where your defense needs more help before deciding which tower to place or improve next.

pages.title: Sworded.io - Spin and Rub.
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Sworded.io - Spin and Rub. puts you in sword fights against waves of enemies. Keep moving as you take on the next group and build up your character between encounters. Unlock weapons and magic spells as you progress. Try different equipment as the battles change and use it to find an opening against the attackers.

pages.title: Crab Guards
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Crab Guards puts you against waves of crab-masked enemies. Fight with weapons ranging from pistols and shotguns to sniper rifles and flamethrowers. Use the sights to line up a shot, account for recoil and watch for a gap before reloading. Survive the waves and spend the cash you earn on more gear.

pages.title: K-Pop Hunter Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: K-Pop Hunter Fashion lets you style idols with a mix of stage fashion and gothic demon-hunter clothing. Try leather jackets, spiked boots and neon hairstyles, then choose makeup and accessories to finish each look. Pick which details should stand out, from a bright hair color to a darker outfit with fantasy jewelry.

pages.title: Hexa Block: Honey Cells
pages.creator: GreeMead
pages.description: Hexa Block: Honey Cells gives you shapes made of hexagons to fit into a board. Drag each shape from below into open cells. The pieces keep their original orientation, so look at the spaces you will leave for the ones you have not placed yet. Fill the whole board without a timer or move limit.

pages.title: Rope Rescue! - Unique Puzzle
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description: Rope Rescue! - Unique Puzzle asks you to build a zipline that gets everyone to safety. Hold and drag the left mouse button to set the rope's route, then hold the button to let people onto it. Check where the rope passes before starting the rescue. A route that looks short can take the riders through a trap.

pages.title: Sword And Spin
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Sword And Spin gives you a greatsword to swing while racing through obstacle courses. Spin the blade to cut through enemies and barriers in your path. Watch what is coming up before moving into range, since the next stretch can mix opponents with obstacles. Get through the course and take on the next layout.

pages.title: Rotate Rings - Circle Puzzle
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Rotate Rings - Circle Puzzle gives you a set of colorful rings to turn. Rotate them until the sections line up in the arrangement the puzzle needs. Check how a turn changes the neighboring rings before moving another one. Work through the layouts by finding a sequence that gets the pieces into alignment.

pages.title: Spider Evolution
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Spider Evolution starts you as a small spider on a track with rivals and obstacles. Move sideways to dodge hazards and look for chances to merge and grow stronger. Steer with the arrow keys or A and D, or use the mouse. Keep developing the spider as you work your way through the course.

pages.title: Merge Hospital
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Merge Hospital casts you as Doctor Player in a hospital with stories to uncover. Use generators to make medical supplies, pies and other items, then combine matching items to build up the hospital. Each use of a generator costs energy. When it runs out, wait for it to refill or replenish it through the shop. Meet the surgeons and other staff as their stories unfold.

pages.title: Construction Truck: Building Games for Kids
pages.creator: Individual entrepreneur DENIS KLIMAV
pages.description: Construction Truck: Building Games for Kids takes you through construction activities where you drive vehicles and build houses. Follow the prompts to see which vehicle or task comes next. Work on a building one step at a time and explore the other jobs the game gives you as the site comes together.

pages.title: Rolling Balls Sea Race
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Rolling Balls Sea Race challenges you to roll a ball to the finish without falling into the water. Collect coins along the course to unlock new balls, trails and sky designs. Play a course by yourself or race a second player. Watch the edges when turning, since a pickup is only useful if you can stay on the route.

pages.title: Animal Transform Race
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Animal Transform Race lets you change animals during a race. Each animal moves quickly on some parts of the course and slowly on others, so switch as the terrain changes. Earn coins to unlock more animals. Play a two-player race with keyboard shortcuts for each racer, or use the mouse or touch controls to change forms.

pages.title: BUBBLE FEVER BLAST
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: BUBBLE FEVER BLAST asks you to clear bubbles by shooting at groups of the same color. Watch for a chance to send a bubble into the star, which can trigger Fever. Aim where the next match will free some space. If the bubbles reach the bottom line, the game ends.

pages.title: The Prism City Detectives
pages.creator: CGSpot
pages.description: The Prism City Detectives follows Luna, Ruby, Skye, Willow, Daisy, Violet and Lumi as they try to restore color to their monochrome city. Choose outfits for the detectives, then search for hidden objects and gems of different colors. Bring the gems together to make the Rainbow Gem and restore the city's colors.

pages.title: Nuts & Bolts Puzzle
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Nuts & Bolts Puzzle gives you jelly plates pinned to a board. Unscrew a fastener and move it to a different slot to free the pieces it is holding. Think about where the plate will go and what the next pin is supporting. Clear the plates with as few moves as you can, or unlock the harder mode for a greater challenge.

pages.title: Santa Claus vs Christmas Gifts
pages.creator: Best Games
pages.description: Santa Claus vs Christmas Gifts gives Santa a field of numbered presents to shoot. The number shows how many hits each gift can take before it bursts. Aim with the mouse and work on reducing the remaining numbers. Clear every present to finish the stage and move on through the game's thirty levels.

pages.title: Dirt Bike Mad Skills
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Dirt Bike Mad Skills puts you on a motorcycle for stunt courses through valleys and canyons. Pick a bike, then work your way over the terrain and across the dangerous stretches. Pay attention to where the bike will land after a jump. Take on the courses alone or play in the two-player mode.

pages.title: My Quarantine Glam Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: My Quarantine Glam Look puts you in charge of an at-home makeup session with Skyler, Sunny, Ruby and Violet. Choose blush, eyeshadow, eye color and lipstick for each of the Rainbow Girls. Try different pink shades and see how they look together. Give each friend her own style or repeat a favorite color across the group.

pages.title: Fresh N Fresh Tiles
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Fresh N Fresh Tiles is a matching puzzle where selected tiles move into a tray at the bottom. Make a set of three identical tiles to clear them from the tray. Space is limited, so look for a way to finish a set before picking a tile that takes up another slot.

pages.title: Wild West Freecell
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Wild West Freecell asks you to move all the cards onto four foundations, building each suit from ace to king. On the tableau, build downward by alternating colors and use the free cells to hold cards temporarily. Collect pistol cards for an action that can move a tableau card to the front of a column. Choose from four difficulty levels.

pages.title: Hangman With Buddies
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hangman With Buddies lets you guess a hidden word while playing live against other people. Choose letters and use the ones you reveal to narrow down the answer. Wrong guesses put the stick figure closer to the river and its crocodiles. Work out the word before the figure falls in.

pages.title: Mangavania
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Mangavania follows Yuhiko, a young ninja who descends into the underworld to find a cure for his brother. Explore pixel-art dungeons, fight monsters and bosses, and discover abilities that open up new ways to get through the rooms. Free lost souls and help the small Spirits you meet. Some share advice or reveal more of the story.

pages.title: Clear The Lot
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Clear The Lot asks you to move parked vehicles from a garage onto a busy road. Watch the traffic and send a car out when there is a safe gap. A vehicle that leaves too early can hit one already passing. Find an opening for each car until the garage is empty.

pages.title: Unblock Puzzle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Unblock Puzzle gives you a red block trapped behind other pieces. Slide the pieces to open a path to the exit, using as few moves as you can. Work through 240 puzzles across four difficulties, from Beginner to Expert. If a layout has you stuck, use the hint to help find a way through.

pages.title: Slope Extra
pages.description: Slope Extra sends a ball rolling down ramps at increasing speed. Move the mouse left or right to steer, or swipe on a touch screen. Watch the slope ahead so you can move around an obstacle before the ball gets to it. The run keeps going as long as you can stay clear of the hazards.

pages.title: Ancient Dragons Princess
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Ancient Dragons Princess lets you style Princess Rennie for a feast, a ball or a hunt. Browse velvet and brocade dresses, riding clothes, medieval hairstyles and jewelry. Then create a dragon to go with her. Choose the dragon's appearance separately so it can have a look of its own or match the princess's outfit.

pages.title: Halloween Sudoku
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Halloween Sudoku replaces numbers with Halloween items. Fill the empty cells so each item appears once in every row, column and three-by-three box. Check which symbols are missing from the groups that meet at a blank. Use those clues to narrow down what belongs there and complete the grid.

pages.title: Shower Run 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Shower Run 3D challenges you to gather bath bubbles while moving through obstacles. Slide to steer toward pickups and keep away from barriers that can cost you bubbles. The run ends if you lose all of them. You can also start with super bubbles to give yourself more room for a mistake.

pages.title: Tictoc KPOP Fashion
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Tictoc KPOP Fashion asks you to style a girl for her K-pop reels. Follow the hints when choosing makeup and clothes, then post the look and see how many likes it earns. Use the likes to buy more items. New choices in the wardrobe give you more options for the next reel.

pages.title: Twisty Roads!
pages.creator: syderzone
pages.description: Twisty Roads! puts you on a route that gets harder to drive as you go. Pass through checkpoints to add to your score and pick up coins when you can reach them. Use the coins to buy more vehicles. Watch how the road bends before choosing your line through the next turn.

pages.title: Dalo
pages.creator: Protection Games
pages.description: Dalo asks you to trace a route that uses every line exactly once. Start at a dot and move along the connections without going over one again. Think about where you will end up after entering a branch, since the path still needs to reach every unused line. You can also create and share puzzles or try boards made by other players.

pages.title: Sticka Stacka
pages.creator: RodaGames
pages.description: Sticka Stacka gives you a picture cut into rows that are out of order. Drag the rows until the image makes sense from top to bottom. Finish within the time limit to earn a star and unlock the picture for your Sticker Book. There are 130 puzzles to work through.

pages.title: Math Games For Adults
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Math Games For Adults combines equations with a crossword-style board. Move pieces into place to solve addition, subtraction, multiplication and division problems. A correct line turns green, and an incorrect one turns red. Keep adjusting the intersecting equations until the board is green. Choose a difficulty that suits the kind of challenge you want.

pages.title: ANIME GIRLS MEMORY CARD
pages.creator: TWO PLAYERS GAME STUDIO
pages.description: ANIME GIRLS MEMORY CARD is a matching game with illustrated anime characters. Turn cards over and remember where each image appeared so you can return to it when you find its pair. The number of cards grows in later levels and new pictures are added, giving you more positions to keep track of.

pages.title: Mini Dash
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Mini Dash follows a small blob through retro platform levels. Use an air dash to cross spaces and evade hazards that would get in the way of a normal jump. Look at the route to the coins before committing to a move. Collect the coins as you work your way through each layout.

pages.title: Flex Run 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Flex Run 3D gives you a character who can change poses to avoid furniture. Tap and drag to move into a position that fits around the obstacle. The movements differ when there are two characters instead of one. At the finish wall, adjust the pose again to fit the numbered openings on the incoming purple walls.

pages.title: Big Bird Racing
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Big Bird Racing lets up to four people race birds at the same time on one keyboard. Pick a bird and compete across nine race types. Each event gives you a different way to get ahead, so watch how the race works before trying to outrun the other birds. Finish first to beat your friends.

pages.title: Bullet Jakke Adventure
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Bullet Jakke Adventure gives you a cannon and sends Jake flying as far as possible. Launch him, then use ammunition to give him another push while he is in the air. Collect coins during the flight. Spend them on upgrades such as more ammunition, a rocket backpack or a stronger cannon before the next attempt.

pages.title: Bobby Horse Makeover
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Bobby Horse Makeover gets a horse named Bobby ready for a ride. Start with the care activities and check her horseshoes before choosing her outfit. Browse the available accessories and pick pieces that go together. Finish the practical tasks and dress Bobby up so she is ready for the next day's ride.

pages.title: Deer Hunter 2D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Deer Hunter 2D gives you thirty levels of sniper shooting. Look for the deer in the scene and line up your shot before you fire. Tap to play and watch how the target moves when deciding when to shoot. Complete each hunting challenge to work through the remaining levels.

pages.title: Jewel Magic
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Jewel Magic asks you to swap jewels and make rows of three or more of the same color. Clear them to score points and set up larger matches that create bombs. Use earned power-ups if a layout is difficult. Reach the level's target before your moves or time run out.

pages.title: Mr. Hunter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Mr. Hunter is a 2D shooter with fifty levels of targets to take on. Check where the enemies are placed and aim before taking your shot. The targets change from one stage to the next, so use the new layout to decide how to approach each one. Work through the levels as you improve your aim.

pages.title: Mandala Kids
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Mandala Kids gives you mandala patterns to color. Pick a design and choose the colors you want for its different sections. Try repeating a shade around the pattern or changing it from one area to the next. Switch to another mandala when you want to work on a different layout.

pages.title: Make A Roller Coaster
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Make A Roller Coaster gives you a route to draw for a roller coaster. Pass through every green circle and stay clear of the red ones on the way to the station. After drawing the path, press and hold to speed up the ride. Earn enough rewards to unlock different coaster looks.

pages.title: Cake Master Shop
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Cake Master Shop takes you through mixing, baking and decorating cakes. Put the ingredients in bowls and blend them before the batter goes into the oven. Pick fruit for the finishing touches and use the kitchen tools as you work through the recipe. Complete levels to unlock more cakes to make.

pages.title: Kings and Queens Solitaire Tripeaks
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Kings and Queens Solitaire Tripeaks is a card puzzle where you clear a layout by choosing cards one rank higher or lower than the current card. Look for a move that reveals another card you can use. Plan a short sequence when several cards are available, and keep clearing the tableau as you move through the solitaire journey.

pages.title: Stunt Crasher
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Stunt Crasher sends a vehicle off a ramp and into obstacles. Aim for a launch that causes more destruction, since a bigger crash earns more points. Buy a different vehicle or improve the one you have before trying the next stage. See how changes to the vehicle affect what it hits after leaving the ramp.

pages.title: Rope Slash
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Rope Slash asks you to knock down cans by cutting the rope that holds a ball. Look at where the ball will swing or fall before making the cut. A well-timed release can send it into more than one can. Smash every can in the layout to move on to the next puzzle.

pages.title: What Is Wrong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: What Is Wrong shows you a picture with one thing that does not belong. Look around the scene and choose the item that makes the least sense there. Think about how the objects relate to what is happening in the picture. Find the odd detail in each of the twelve levels.

pages.title: Painting Vintage Cars Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Painting Vintage Cars Jigsaw Puzzle gives you eight paintings of vintage cars to reassemble. Choose a picture and pick a grid of two by three, three by four or four by six pieces. Drag the fragments into place. Look for lines in the bodywork or background that continue into another piece.

pages.title: Press the different Shaped Quadrangle
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Press the different Shaped Quadrangle asks you to find the four-sided shape that differs from the others. Compare the outlines and click or tap the one that stands out before time runs out. Each choice gives you another comparison to make. Keep spotting the odd shapes to work toward the game's titles.

pages.title: Frontline Commando Survival
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Frontline Commando Survival gives you shooter missions with a different briefing at each level. Read the objective, then move through the area and take out the enemies while staying alive. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, the mouse to aim and fire, and G to throw a grenade. C switches between first-person and third-person views.

pages.title: Math Game
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Math Game gives you a series of calculations to answer. Work out each operation and choose the result before moving on. Correct answers build your score, and the percentage gives you a way to track your accuracy. See how close you can get to a perfect result as the questions continue.

pages.title: Easter Eggs Collection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Easter Eggs Collection asks you to gather the requested eggs before the clock runs out. Drag through adjacent eggs of the same kind to make a chain of at least three. The path can turn horizontally, vertically or diagonally. Longer matches can give bonuses, and linking more than seven eggs adds time.

pages.title: Tank VS Golems 2
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Tank VS Golems 2 puts you in a tank facing approaching golems. Move the tank into position and fire at the enemies as they come into range. Keep watching the direction of the next attacker while you deal with the ones already close. Your aim is to stop the golems with the tank's shots.

pages.title: Ninja Run
pages.creator: GameNing
pages.description: Ninja Run sends a ninja across wooden bridges with bombs in the way. Tap to jump when you reach a hazard, and collect coins on the route. Watch the next stretch so you can time the jump before it is too late. Traveling farther raises your score.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Bathroom Hygiene
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Bathroom Hygiene follows Hazel as she learns to clean up the bathroom. Help her clear the mess, deal with a clogged basin and wash the stained accessories. The activities also cover personal hygiene. Work through the tasks with Hazel as she gets the room and her own routine in order.

pages.title: Ninja Run
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Ninja Run sends a ninja along an endless course. Jump over the obstacles and collect shurikens as you go. Watch the spacing between hazards so you can time the next jump after landing. The longer you keep the run going, the more opportunities you have to pick up shurikens.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Spa Makeover
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Spa Makeover gets Hazel ready for Kayla's birthday party. Help her mother with the home spa activities, including caring for Hazel's nails and toes. Then apply light makeup and choose a party outfit with matching accessories. Finish the makeover before Ashley arrives to pick Hazel up.

pages.title: Train Simulator 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Train Simulator 3D puts you in charge of driving a series of trains. Use the mouse to adjust the accelerator and brakes as you go. Build up speed when there is room to travel, then slow down when the route calls for it. The challenge is finding the right balance between power and braking.

pages.title: Bike Racing Game 2019 : Extreme Bike Race
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Bike Racing Game 2019 : Extreme Bike Race puts you on a motorcycle racing against rivals. Keep your bike under control at speed and watch where the other riders are as you head through the track. Look for a chance to get past them without crashing. Finish ahead of the field to win the race.

pages.title: Mazda 3 Sedan Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Mazda 3 Sedan Puzzle has six pictures of the Mazda 3 sedan to rebuild. Choose a picture and decide whether to solve it with 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Compare the edges and colors as you assemble the image. The larger layouts split the same car details into smaller fragments.

pages.title: Love Birds Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Love Birds Puzzle offers twelve pictures to put together. Choose an image and place the scattered pieces where they belong. Look for details that continue from one piece to another, such as part of a bird or a stretch of background. Complete the picture before picking another from the collection.

pages.title: EG Cartoon Candy
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Cartoon Candy asks you to trace links through matching candy pictures. Use the mouse or touch controls to connect the candies and clear them from the board. Look for a group you can reach in one continuous move, then find the next match in the new layout. Keep making connections before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Foot Doctor
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Foot Doctor gives you a clinic with young patients whose feet are injured. Use the mouse to choose and apply the game's tools as you work through each patient's treatment. The tasks change with the injury, so follow the activity on screen to finish caring for the foot before moving on.

pages.title: Ultimate Angry Cat
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Ultimate Angry Cat gives you a slingshot to launch a cat toward stars. Pull back with the mouse to set the direction and strength, then release and watch the flight. Look at where the stars are spread across the level before taking the shot. Gather them all to complete the challenge.

pages.title: Zen Block
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Zen Block gives you a set of shapes to fit together into a square. Move each piece with the mouse and check the space it leaves behind. A shape can fit in more than one place, so think about which position leaves room for the rest. Fill the square to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Epic
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Jigsaw Puzzle Epic gives you a library of pictures organized into collections. Choose a picture and use the mouse to put its pieces together. Look for colors or outlines that continue from one fragment to the next. Once the picture is complete, you can pick another subject from the collection.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Colors Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Tic Tac Toe Colors Game is a version of noughts and crosses. Take turns claiming squares on the grid and try to make a line of three. Watch the rows, columns and diagonals as the board fills. Block an opponent's line when you need to, or set up one of your own.

pages.title: Summer Coloring Pages
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Summer Coloring Pages offers six summer pictures and 24 colors. Choose a drawing and apply shades to the parts you want to color. Finishing quickly can improve your score, or you can experiment with different palettes. Save the finished image or print it if you want to keep a copy.

pages.title: Monster Truck Puzzle 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Monster Truck Puzzle 2 gives you six monster truck pictures to assemble. Select an image and choose 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Use a tire tread, a patch of bodywork or part of the background to work out where pieces fit. Switch to a higher piece count for a harder version of the same picture.

pages.title: Ez Mahjong
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Ez Mahjong gives you a layout of tiles to clear in matching pairs. Choose a pair that opens up more options, then keep removing tiles to finish the board. Faster clears earn bonus points. Use the tutorial to learn the moves, or undo a choice if you spot a better match.

pages.title: Adam and Eve: Cut the Ropes
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Adam and Eve: Cut the Ropes puts Adam in a tangle of snake ropes. Cut them in an order that lets him reach Eve below. Look at what will still be holding him after the first cut and use the remaining ropes to guide his path. Collect all three apples for a bonus as you work through the sixty puzzles.

pages.title: Crazy Chopper
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: Crazy Chopper has you pilot a helicopter through cities, snowy areas and deserts. Tap and hold to control the flight while avoiding things in the air, including parachutes and jets. Watch the space around the helicopter before changing its path. See how far you can keep flying through the different environments.

pages.title: Cube Jump
pages.creator: Fr Games
pages.description: Cube Jump sends a cube across platforms in space. Time each jump so it lands on the next surface instead of falling. Pick up small coins as you cross and use them to unlock other characters. Keep watching where you can land while deciding whether a coin is worth reaching for.

pages.title: Goal Keeper
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Goal Keeper puts you in front of the net to stop incoming shots. Watch the ball and move to save it before it gets past you. The opponent sometimes throws tomatoes as a distraction. Keep your attention on the balls and try to make as many saves as possible.

pages.title: Feet Skin Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Feet Skin Doctor gives you a cartoon clinic appointment focused on foot care. Use the game's tools to work through the different skin problems shown on screen. The activities include devices such as a laser and an electric tool. After the treatment, choose colors for a pedicure to finish the visit.

pages.title: EG Head Soccer
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Head Soccer lets you choose a player and take on a computer opponent. Move into position and jump to meet the ball with your player's head. Aim to send it into the opposing goal while defending your own. Watch the height of the ball as it comes back so you can time your next jump.

pages.title: Bob The Robber 2
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Bob The Robber 2 gives Bob a series of buildings to sneak into to protect the city. Stay out of sight of cameras, pick locks and deal with guards as you search for a way forward. Watch out for zombies as well. The route through each building depends on what you can get past without being caught.

pages.title: Foot Doctor
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Foot Doctor puts you in a virtual emergency room treating injuries to patients' feet. Use the mouse to work through the tools and tasks the game presents. Check which area needs attention before choosing the next tool. Finish the treatment sequence to complete the visit.

pages.title: Handless Millionaire 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Handless Millionaire 2 asks you to grab cash from the other side of a moving guillotine. Wait for the blade to lift, then reach through and pull back before it drops. Watch the timing rather than going straight for the money. There are fifteen stages, with harder challenges as you advance.

pages.title: Spot The Spot
pages.creator: Next Realm Games
pages.description: Spot The Spot asks you to find a red circle among the other circles. Scan the screen and select the red one as soon as you see it. Quick choices earn points that you can spend on upgrades. Keep looking for the target as the arrangement changes and try to improve your reaction time.

pages.title: Girls Surf Contest
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Girls Surf Contest helps Ellie, Annie and Rachel get ready for a surf event. Pick swimwear and a surfboard for the princess you want to style. Try different combinations to see how the board and outfit look together. Finish the look before she takes part in the contest.

pages.title: Sweet Elephants Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Sweet Elephants Jigsaw lets you put together three pictures of elephants. Pick one and choose a puzzle with 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Look for a detail such as an ear or part of the background that continues across two fragments. Try to complete the chosen picture as quickly as you can.

pages.title: HelloKids Coloring Time
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: HelloKids Coloring Time gives you animal drawings to color in a digital coloring book. Browse seven animal themes and choose a picture from more than eighty options. Apply colors to the parts of the drawing you want to change, then pick another animal when you are ready to start a new picture.

pages.title: Rachel Perfect Wedding!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Rachel Perfect Wedding! lets you prepare Rachel for her wedding. Try the makeup choices and decide what suits the look you want for her. Then browse the wedding dresses and choose one to go with the makeup. You can change either part as you work toward the finished bridal look.

pages.title: Pony Cooking Rainbow Cake
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Pony Cooking Rainbow Cake takes you shopping for ingredients before you help a pony bake a cake. Follow the recipe steps as the game shows them, from getting the supplies to preparing the dessert. Once the cake is ready, choose decorations and colorful details to finish its rainbow design.

pages.title: Hero BFFs Pregnant Check up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Hero BFFs Pregnant Check up follows two superhero friends as they go to a final checkup before their babies arrive. Tap through the game's clinic activities and use the tools it gives you. After the appointment, move on to the other activities, including preparing smoothies for the two friends.
